# Preparation

## Load packages

```{r load-packages}
#| error: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| output: false
if (!requireNamespace("pacman", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(
  tidyverse,
  janitor,
  afex,
  emmeans,
  effectsize,
  MBESS,
  RRreg,
  parameters,
  lme4,
  lmerTest,
  marginaleffects,
  apaTables,
  knitr,
  kableExtra
)
```

## Import data

```{r import-data}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| output: false
dat <- read_csv("processed_data/s1_data_cleaned.csv") |>
  mutate(across(c(id, completed, condition, d_attention, gender), as.factor)) |>
  filter(d_attention == "Pass", completed == 1)
```

# Analysis

## Correlation matrices

Zero-order correlation between key variables in each condition:

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Baseline

```{r correlation-matrix-baseline}
apa.cor.table(
  data = dat |>
    filter(condition == "baseline") |>
    select(match, ee, pn, ne, d_score)
)
```

### CP

```{r correlation-matrix-cp}
apa.cor.table(
  data = dat |>
    filter(condition == "cp") |>
    select(match, ee, pn, ne, d_score)
)
```

### Norm

```{r correlation-matrix-norm}
apa.cor.table(
  data = dat |>
    filter(condition == "norm") |>
    select(match, ee, pn, ne, d_score)
)
```

:::

## Conditional norms

```{r conditional-norms-data}
dat_l_reg <- dat |>
  select(id, condition, cee_1:cne_5) |>
  pivot_longer( # 15 observations per participant
    cols = cee_1:cne_5,
    names_to = c("measure", "m_level"),
    names_pattern = "(.*)_(.*)",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  pivot_wider( # 5 observations per participant
    names_from = "measure",
    values_from = "value"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    m_level = as.numeric(m_level),
    m_level.c = m_level - 3 # Centre to the middle value
  )
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Empirical expectations

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Linear mixed-effects model

```{r lme-conditional-empirical-expectations}
mod_cee <- lmer(
  cee ~ condition * m_level.c + (1 + m_level.c | id),
  data = dat_l_reg
)
model_parameters(mod_cee)

me_cee <- avg_slopes(
  model = mod_cee,
  variables = "m_level.c",
  by = "condition",
  re.form = NA
)
me_cee
hypotheses(model = me_cee, hypothesis = ~ pairwise, multcomp = "bonferroni")
```

#### ANOVA at low match prevalence

```{r anova-conditional-empirical-expectations-low-match-prevalence}
#| message: false
dat_l_reg_cee_l <- dat_l_reg |> filter(m_level == 1)
mod_anova_cee_l <- aov_car(cee ~ condition + Error(id), data = dat_l_reg_cee_l)
nice(mod_anova_cee_l, es = "pes")
effectsize::eta_squared(mod_anova_cee_l, ci = 0.9, alternative = "two.sided")

emm_anova_cee_l <- emmeans(mod_anova_cee_l, ~ condition)
emm_anova_cee_l |>
  kable(digits = 2) |>
  kable_minimal(full_width = FALSE)
pairs(emm_anova_cee_l, adjust = "tukey")

# Cohen's d: CP - Norm (not model-based effect size)
effectsize::cohens_d(
  cee ~ condition,
  data = dat_l_reg_cee_l[dat_l_reg_cee_l$condition != "baseline", ]
)
# Cohen's d: Baseline - Norm (not model-based effect size)
effectsize::cohens_d(
  cee ~ condition,
  data = dat_l_reg_cee_l[dat_l_reg_cee_l$condition != "cp", ]
)
# Cohen's d: Baseline - CP (not model-based effect size)
effectsize::cohens_d(
  cee ~ condition,
  data = dat_l_reg_cee_l[dat_l_reg_cee_l$condition != "norm", ]
)
```

## Dishonesty and D-factor

```{r d-internal-consistency-and-descriptives}
d_items <- paste0("d_", 1:16)
MBESS::ci.reliability(data = dat[d_items], type = "alpha")$est
MBESS::ci.reliability(data = dat[d_items], type = "omega")$est

# D16 descriptives
mean(dat$d_score)
sd(dat$d_score)
```

```{r logistic-regression-d-score}
dat_d_reg <- dat |>
  select(match, condition, d_score) |>
  mutate(d_score_z = as.vector(scale(d_score)))

mod_d_reg <- RRlog(
  match ~ condition * d_score_z,
  data = dat_d_reg,
  model = "FR",
  p = c(0, 0.2)
)
summary(mod_d_reg)

mod_d_reg_coef <- RRlog(
  match ~ 0 + condition + condition:d_score_z,
  data = dat_d_reg,
  model = "FR",
  p = c(0, 0.2)
)
summary(mod_d_reg_coef)
```

## Preregistered analyses

Here we report preregistered analyses that are not reported in the main text.

::: {.panel-tabset}

### H8

```{r H8}
#| message: false
mod_anova_cee_20_30 <- aov_car(
  cee ~ condition + Error(id),
  data = dat_l_reg |> filter(m_level == 3)
)
nice(mod_anova_cee_20_30, es = "pes")
effectsize::eta_squared(
  mod_anova_cee_20_30,
  ci = 0.9,
  alternative = "two.sided"
)

emm_anova_cee_20_30 <- emmeans(mod_anova_cee_20_30, ~ condition)
emm_anova_cee_20_30 |>
  kable(digits = 2) |>
  kable_minimal(full_width = FALSE)

# Test H8
contrast(emm_anova_cee_20_30, method = list(baseline_vs_cp = c(1, -1, 0)))
effectsize::cohens_d(
  x = dat_l_reg |> filter(m_level == 3, condition == "baseline") |> pull(cee),
  y = dat_l_reg |> filter(m_level == 3, condition == "cp") |> pull(cee)
)
```

### H9

```{r H9}
#| message: false
mod_anova_cee_30_50 <- aov_car(
  cee ~ condition * m_level + Error(id/m_level),
  data = dat_l_reg |>
    filter(m_level > 3) |>
    mutate(m_level = droplevels(as.factor(m_level)))
)
nice(mod_anova_cee_30_50, es = "pes")
effectsize::eta_squared(
  mod_anova_cee_30_50,
  ci = 0.9,
  alternative = "two.sided",
  partial = TRUE
)

emm_anova_cee_30_50 <- emmeans(mod_anova_cee_30_50, ~ condition)
emm_anova_cee_30_50 |>
  kable(digits = 2) |>
  kable_minimal(full_width = FALSE)

# Test H9
contrast(emm_anova_cee_30_50, method = list(baseline_vs_cp = c(1, -1, 0)))
effectsize::cohens_d(
  x = dat_l_reg |> filter(m_level == 4, condition == "baseline") |> pull(cee),
  y = dat_l_reg |> filter(m_level == 4, condition == "cp") |> pull(cee)
)
effectsize::cohens_d(
  x = dat_l_reg |> filter(m_level == 5, condition == "baseline") |> pull(cee),
  y = dat_l_reg |> filter(m_level == 5, condition == "cp") |> pull(cee)
)
```
